properties.notes: Reconfiguration and extension of the first floor to create 7 x 2 bedroom units and 2 x 1 bedroom units. Construction of additional storey to provide 8 x 3 bedroom maisonettes (creating 9 additional units and 17 in total). Provision of a first floor shared communal amenity space, 23 new parking spaces, 48 cycle storage spaces and oneloading bay. Amalgamation, change of use and extension of three existing commercial units at ground floor level to provide a large food retail (Class A1) unit. Extension and change of use of theremaining ground floor retail units (Class A1) to a flexible Class A1/A2/A3 use. New ground floor refuse and recycling.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
